question: On 6th July 2025, Prime Minister Narendra Modi paid tribute to which leader known for founding the Bharatiya Jana Sangh and sacrificing his life for India's unity and integrity?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dr. Syama Prasad Mookerjee**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Dr. Syama Prasad Mookerjee** was the founder of the **Bharatiya Jana Sangh**, which later evolved into the **Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP)**, one of India's largest political parties.
 
• He was a firm advocate of **India's unity and integrity** and opposed the special status granted to Jammu and Kashmir under Article 370.
 
• Dr. Mookerjee sacrificed his life while protesting against the special autonomy of Jammu and Kashmir, which he believed was harmful to India's unity. His motto was, "**Ek Vidhan, Ek Nishan, Ek Pradhan**" (One Constitution, One Flag, One Leader).
 
• He was a respected politician, educationist, and intellectual. He served as the **Minister for Industry and Supply** in the first cabinet of independent India under Prime Minister Jawaharlal Nehru.
 
• On 6th July 2025, **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** paid tribute to Dr. Syama Prasad Mookerjee for his contributions to the nation and his role in laying the foundation for modern Indian politics.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Dr. Syama Prasad Mookerjee:**

 
 
• He was born on **6th July 1901** in **Kolkata, West Bengal**, and passed away on **23rd June 1953** under mysterious circumstances while in custody in Jammu and Kashmir.
 
• He was instrumental in establishing the **Bharatiya Jana Sangh** in **1951** to promote nationalism and counter the policies of the Congress party.
 
• Dr. Mookerjee was a key figure in the **Bengal Partition movement**, which ensured that a part of Bengal remained with India during the partition in 1947.
 
• He held the position of **Vice-Chancellor of Calcutta University** at the age of 33, making significant contributions to education and academic excellence.
 
 
 
• **Article 370:**
 
 
• Article 370 of the Indian Constitution granted special status to Jammu and Kashmir, allowing it to have its own constitution and autonomy over internal matters, except defense, communications, and foreign affairs.
 
• Dr. Mookerjee strongly opposed Article 370, emphasizing the importance of **national integration** and equal status for all states within the Indian Union.
 
• His protest against the special status led to his arrest and eventual death, which remains a subject of controversy and speculation.
 
• In **2019**, Article 370 was abrogated by the Government of India, fulfilling one of Dr. Mookerjee's key ideologies.
 
 
 
• **Other leaders mentioned in the options:**
 
 
• **Pandit Deendayal Upadhyaya:** He was an Indian politician and philosopher known for his concept of **Integral Humanism**, which became the guiding philosophy of the BJP.
 
• **Bal Gangadhar Tilak:** A prominent freedom fighter and social reformer, he was known as the **Father of Indian Unrest** and played a significant role in India's independence movement.
 
• **Lala Lajpat Rai:** He was a key leader in the Indian independence movement and earned the title **Punjab Kesari**. He actively protested against colonial rule, including the Simon Commission.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Legacy of Dr. Syama Prasad Mookerjee:**

 
 
• His contributions laid the foundation for the **nationalist political movement** in India, which continues to influence Indian politics today.
 
• He is remembered for his unwavering commitment to **national unity** and his efforts to integrate Jammu and Kashmir fully with India.
 
• His death sparked debates on the treatment of political dissenters and the importance of transparency in governance.
 
 
 
• **Tributes:**
 
 
• Institutions such as **Syama Prasad Mookerjee Port Trust** and several educational institutions have been named after him.
 
• Prime Minister Narendra Modi and the BJP often highlight his contributions as part of their political discourse and policies.
 
• Annual tributes are paid on his birth and death anniversaries to honor his legacy.
